title: "Heavenly Fate Key Intelligence"
next_chapter_hook: As the mysterious helper stepped across the threshold and glanced back, those words carved themselves into Chen Ji's heart like frost—"Your master, too, chose to trust at this very step."

text.content:
Midnight, the Bamboo Grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the Blue Stone, spiritual mist swirling around him. The fragmentary Tianji Record floated three inches before his brow center, its yellowed pages flickering with runes that seemed to transmit some kind of message. Suddenly, a cold Demonic Path aura pierced through from the southeast, coalescing into a pitch-black communication Jade Slip deep within the bamboo grove.

He opened his eyes, his gaze平静得近乎漠然. He recognized this aura—it was Ye Qing's unique "Yinming Demonic Breath."

dialogue.content:
(From the Jade Slip came Ye Qing's low voice, bearing rare gravity)

"Chen Ji, our intelligence network has found a lead. The Holy Sect has a secret realm in the depths of the Northern Wasteland, called the 'Heavenly Fate Altar.' Your target... is very likely there."

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingertips lightly tapped the Jade Slip, receiving the message in full. The Northern Wasteland—that was a deadly forbidden zone even the three great Sects regarded with caution, perpetually shrouded in chaotic turbulence. He had anticipated the Holy Sect would hide Chen Nian in a perilous location, yet he never imagined it would be such a place.

Before the Jade Slip could fade, another fluctuation emerged from it—this time not a voice, but a projection of light and shadow.

dialogue.content:
(Within the projection appeared a yellowed Sheepskin Scroll, marked with countless routes and forbidden symbols)

"This is a secret map I, of the Demonic Path, spent thirty years infiltrating the Holy Sect to obtain. The secret realm's defenses, patrol schedules, forbidden mechanisms... it's all here. In three days, the Holy Sect will have a large-scale personnel rotation, and the guards will certainly be lax."

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at the light-and-shadow map, his gaze slowly sweeping across each marking. His memory was already exceptional, and with days of repeated deduction, he had already memorized it by heart. However, as he prepared to sever the communication, the Jade Slip suddenly trembled violently.

An unfamiliar and ancient aura seeped through a rift in the Void.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the Tianji Record Fragment, his murky eyes flashing with rare sharpness)

"He's here. Faster than I anticipated."

text.content:
Before the words faded, a faint light suddenly gleamed deep within the bamboo grove. That glow was neither Spiritual Light nor Demonic Breath, but rather an ancient and unfamiliar aura. It shot across the sky like a meteor, ultimately materializing into a blurred figure three zhang away from Chen Ji.

His features were indiscernible, even his gender unclear. Yet that hunched back, that posture of leaning on a staff—it all bore the unmistakable weight of years.

dialogue.content:
(Ye Qing's voice from the Jade Slip suddenly tightened)

"Someone's here! I'll cut the connection first—"

"No need."

That unfamiliar voice suddenly spoke, hoarse and low, yet clearly penetrating through space:

"I'm not here to harm him. Ye Qing girl's connection... actually saved me considerable effort."

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze sank slightly, his hand behind his back secretly forming a Dharma seal. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted to his side and whispered, "This person's aura is strange—neither fully human nor fully ghost. But judging by his Spiritual Energy... he's at least a Nascent Soul realm old monster."

Nascent Soul realm. Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet his expression remained unchanged.

The figure slowly turned, drawing a yellowed Sheepskin Scroll from his sleeve.

"The Holy Sect secret realm's three-layer outer forbidden formation map."

Chen Ji did not move.

"The Heavenly Fate Altar construction diagram."

Chen Ji still did not move.

"Chen Nian's imprisonment location, and the distribution of core facilities for the 'Heavenly Fate Key' project."

This time, Chen Ji's eyelashes trembled slightly.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his tone as coldly indifferent as ever)

"No merit, no reward. You visit deep at night and gift such precious items... what do you desire?"

text.content:
The figure fell silent for a moment, then let out a low laugh.

"As cautious as expected. This trait... is indeed like him."

The "him" mentioned in those words clearly referred to someone else. Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, yet he did not pursue the matter.

choice.prompt: The mysterious helper tossed out a test regarding trust, and Chen Ji must choose between the test and his own scheme—whether to deflect force with force, or to watch and wait for the right moment?

choices.text: First probe the other party's background
choices.description: Without revealing anything, probe the connection between the stranger and the previous Tianji Record holder. Know yourself and know your enemy, and you can advance and retreat freely.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the intelligence head start
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial background information to judge the other party's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: If the other party senses the probe, they may leave in anger

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke slowly: "You seem quite familiar with this Tianji Record scroll...?"

The figure tilted his head slightly, as if studying his expression. After a moment, that hoarse voice spoke again: "Familiar? Heh... I'm merely repaying a debt of gratitude for an old friend."

choices.description: Regardless of the other party's motives, first secure the intelligence. When the soldier comes, deploy the general; when water flows, build the earthwork. schemes and overt tactics can all be handled with ease.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Holy Sect secret realm map, gaining key intelligence crucial for rescuing Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The other party's intentions are unclear; they may have planted hidden traps within the intelligence

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped forward, accepting the Sheepskin Scroll. The moment it touched his hand, he immediately sensed the Spiritual Power imprint contained within—this was genuine, completely unaltered.

"Since it is so, I shall not decline."

choices.description: Propose equivalent exchange conditions, transforming this debt into a fair transaction to eliminate potential hidden dangers.
choices.visible_reward: Establish an equal cooperative relationship, enabling more support in the future
choices.risk_hint: If the other party refuses, the deal may fall through

text.content:
"What is your aim? You might as well speak directly," Chen Ji said coolly. "The Tianji Record's holder does not take kindly to owing debts."

The figure fell silent for a long while before speaking: "You truly are of the same lineage. He said the same thing back then."

"An old friend?" Chen Ji caught that word, his brow center jumping slightly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul beside him trembled faintly, as if wanting to say something, yet forcibly restraining itself.

The figure seemed to notice something and chuckled low: "It seems Old Mo hasn't told you everything."

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly solidified further, his voice cold and hard)

"Who exactly are you? I know every Tianji Record holder through the ages—you are not among them!"

text.content:
The figure did not answer, merely giving the Sheepskin Scroll a light shake.

In an instant, countless points of light flew from the scroll, constructing a three-dimensional projection before Chen Ji's eyes. It was the complete structure of the Holy Sect secret realm—the three layers of outer forbidden formations were as impenetrable as an iron barrel, and at the very core, a pitch-black altar stood in the Void.

Above the altar, a slender figure hung suspended by chains, limbs all imprisoned by符文-laden shackles.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

That face—even though blurred, even though concealed by runes, he could recognize it at a glance.

Chen Nian.

His sister, missing for years, was now imprisoned upon that altar, her life uncertain.

dialogue.content:
(Ye Qing's voice suddenly rang from the Jade Slip, carrying suppressed fury)

"The 'Heavenly Fate Key' project... they want to extract her Heavenly Fate origin! Every time Chen Nian is drained, her own lifespan decreases by ten years. Within three years, if no one rescues her, she will be completely exhausted!"

choice.prompt: After learning of his sister's situation, Chen Ji faces a second choice—whether to act immediately or plan thoroughly?

choices.description: Intelligence in hand, opportunity is fleeting. Even if it's risky, act while the guards are distracted.
choices.visible_cost: Preparation time is too short; may miss critical variables
choices.visible_reward: Striking while the Holy Sect is weakest offers the highest chance of success
choices.risk_hint: If the intelligence is wrong or an ambush is encountered, will fall into a desperate situation
choices.process_label: 兵贵神速，不给敌人喘息之机

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fist, his knuckles white from the strain. Three days—only three days. He drew a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the churning emotions: "For the patrol routes three days from now, I want the most detailed version."

choices.description: Any intelligence could be false; first use the Tianji Record to verify key nodes before deciding.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes Heavenly Fate, and may delay timing
choices.visible_reward: Ensures intelligence is accurate; formulate a foolproof strategy
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's consumption may be too great, affecting subsequent operations
choices.process_label: 谋定而后动，知止而有得

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his Divine Sense sinking into the Tianji Record. After a moment, he opened his eyes, a complex glint flashing within: "There will indeed be a large-scale personnel rotation in three days... but the route shown on the map is real."

choices.text: Lay low and plan strategically, advancing gradually
choices.description: No need to rush; continue using the Demonic Path intelligence network and Tianji Record to set up a larger Chess Game, seeking a single decisive strike.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's situation may worsen further
choices.visible_reward: Grasp more Holy Sect inside information; can unite more forces
choices.risk_hint: The pain his sister endures will intensify
choices.process_label: 布局天下，一子落而全局动

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was tranquil as still water: "Three days is too rushed. Give me one month." Ye Qing fell silent for a moment: "One month... she may not survive." Chen Ji did not answer, merely tucking the map into his sleeve: "So this month cannot be wasted."

The mysterious helper quietly watched Chen Ji complete all this, then suddenly spoke: "I have one more thing to tell you."

Chen Ji raised his eyes, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Please speak."

"Beneath that altar lies a fragment of an ancient forbidden artifact. Once triggered, a thousand li in every direction will turn to scorched earth." The figure paused, "Your Mo old man back then... nearly died from this very thing."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently.

Having said this, the figure spoke no more. It slowly turned and walked into the depths of the bamboo grove.

"Wait." Chen Ji suddenly called out.

The back figure paused, but did not turn around.

"Who exactly are you?"

Silence. After a long while, that hoarse voice rang out once more, leaving only a meaningful phrase:

"Your master, too, chose to trust at this very step..."

The moment the words fell, the figure dissolved into the night like a mirage, as if it had never existed.

The bamboo grove returned to silence, save for the rustling of leaves in the night wind.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted to Chen Ji's side, his murky eyes filled with complex emotions: "He spoke truly... I truly nearly died beneath that altar back then. But that was three hundred years ago."

Three hundred years ago. Chen Ji's thoughts raced—didn't that mean this person was at least three hundred years old?

"He mentioned my master." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice so calm it betrayed no emotion. "Mo Xiansheng, who was my master's predecessor...?"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a long while before sighing: "Once you complete this scroll's mission, I will tell you myself."

Always this again. Chen Ji had long grown accustomed to Mo Xiansheng's staged revelations, yet he also knew well—this old man knew far more than he revealed.

He lowered his gaze to the Sheepskin Scroll in his hand, his eyes deep: "Regardless of who he is... this intelligence, I accept."
